title: Target transport for ordinary finite reduction
statement: Let C and C' be small categories with Grothendieck topologies J and J'. Let L : Sh(J) → Sh(J') have right adjoint V with adjunction adj : L ⊣ V and preserve finite limits, and let F : InverseImageData L be the supplied constant-coefficient algebraic inverse-image data. For every commutative Noetherian ring A, ideal I, and n : ℕ, pull F (completedMap F A I), followed by res(coefficientMap J' A I) and change(quotient J' A I n), is naturally isomorphic to change(projection J A I n) followed by pull F (constantMap F (A / I^(n+1))).

source.place: Tags 03EK, 03EL and 093M; target quotient and scalar-associativity transport

proof.text: Compose the finite target quotient restriction transport with the geometric target projection-model transport.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryReducedPull_targetIso
    (V : Sheaf J' (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u)) (adj : L ⊣ V)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty ((pull F (completedMap F A I) ⋙ res (coefficientMap J' A I) ⋙
        change (quotient J' A I n)) ≅
      (change (projection J A I n) ⋙
        pull F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)))))

statement_change.old_statement: For the constant-completion coefficient data, the target finite-reduced functor admits a natural isomorphism to the same canonical finite quotient model change(projection J A I n) followed by pullback along constantMap F (A / I^(n+1)).
statement_change.what: Restore the geometric inverse-image hypotheses of Stacks 03EL. InverseImageData L alone transports ring and module operations but does not assert an adjunction or colimit preservation. Counterexample: take C2-invariants from C2-sets to sets, A = ℤ, I = (2), n = 0, and the completed module ℤ₂ with sign action. Constants and finite limits are preserved and algebraic lifts exist. The completed coefficient ring has trivial action, so completedMap is the identity. The source functor gives (ℤ₂^C2)/2 = 0, while the finite model gives (ℤ₂/2)^C2 = ℤ/2. Thus the original generality is false, even with left exactness. Restore the specified right adjoint and finite-limit preservation, as already assumed by ordinaryReducedPull_transport and the reviewed source-side correction. No definition or target statement changes.
